name: Plastic BagMart
about:
Plastic BagMart operates from Eden Prairie, Minnesota, where it has been family-owned and family-operated for more than three decades. The business began with plastic bags 30 years ago and has since expanded its product lines while remaining under family stewardship.

The company stocks and distributes a broad range of packaging and janitorial supplies, including plastic bags, paper bags, retail packaging, paper products, and credit-card, POS, and cash-register paper. Orders are shipped from its warehouse within 48 hours as a standard service, with rush options available. Plastic BagMart ships any quantity—even less than full cases—via its own local delivery trucks in the surrounding area and by FedEx or common carrier nationwide.

Its customer base spans individual consumers and small to mid-size businesses such as retailers, warehouses, and offices. The assortment is tailored to those segments, and the company emphasizes friendly, personal service regardless of order size.

Founded on a goal of customer satisfaction, Plastic BagMart differentiates itself with a no-minimum-order policy, quantity discounts, a 30-day return window, and the ability to source custom-printed items not listed in its catalog.
